items.description: One place covered by this area

area.description: The original alert area split into individual locations instead of a single long string

cities.description: A list of cities affected by the alert, extracted from the original alert description

area.description: A description of a geographical region, such as 'northeastern Iowa'

counties.description: A list of counties or county-equivalents in the region

locations.description: The regions and counties affected by this alert, extracted from the original alert description

description.description: The original alert description parsed into Markdown, with locations moved to the locations property

instruction.instruction: The original alert instruction with extraneous whitespace removed

parsed.description: Text fields from the original alert, parsed

coordinates.description: A GeoJSON polygon or multipolygon. Please refer to IETF RFC 7946 for information on the GeoJSON format. To comply with the AT Proto Lexicon schema, the coordinates are floating-point numbers encoded as decimal strings.

id.description: The identifier of the alert message.

web.description: The identifier of the hyperlink associating additional information within the alert message.

code.description: The code denoting the special handling of the alert message.

ends.description: The expected end time of the subject event of the alert message.

note.description: The text note accompanying the alert message. Per CAP spec, this should accompany alerts with a status of "Test".

sent.description: The time of the origination of the alert message.

event.description: The text denoting the type of the subject event of the alert message.

onset.description: The expected time of the beginning of the subject event of the alert message.

scope.description: The code denoting the intended distribution of the alert message.

sender.description: Email address of the NWS webmaster.

expires.description: The expiry time of the information of the alert message.

items.description:
UGC identifier for a NWS forecast zone or county.
The first two letters will correspond to either a state code or marine area code (see #/components/schemas/StateTerritoryCode and #/components/schemas/MarineAreaCode for lists of valid letter combinations).
The third letter will be Z for public/fire zone or C for county.

UGC.description: A list of NWS public zone or county identifiers.

SAME.description: A list of SAME (Specific Area Message Encoding) codes for affected counties.

geocode.description: Lists of codes for NWS public zones and counties affected by the alert.

areaDesc.description: A textual description of the area affected by the alert.

category.description: The code denoting the category of the subject event of the alert message.

headline.description: The text headline of the alert message.

language.description: The code denoting the language of the info sub-element of the alert message.

response.description:
The code denoting the type of action recommended for the target audience.
This corresponds to responseType in the CAP specification.

effective.description: The effective time of the information of the alert message.

eventCode.description: System-specific code identifiying the event type of the alert message The keys in this object correspond to eventCode definitions in the NWS CAP specification.

parameters.description:
System-specific additional parameters associated with the alert message.
The keys in this object correspond to parameter definitions in the NWS CAP specification.

id.description: An API link to the prior alert.

sent.description: The time the prior alert was sent.

sender.description: The sender of the prior alert.

identifier.description: The identifier of the alert message.

references.description: A list of prior alerts that this alert updates or replaces.

senderName.description: The text naming the originator of the alert message.

description.description: The text describing the subject event of the alert message.

instruction.description: The text describing the recommended action to be taken by recipients of the alert message.

affectedZones.description: An array of API links for zones affected by the alert. This is an API-specific extension field and is not part of the CAP specification.

properties.description: Alert properties, precisely as provided by api.weather.gov

main.description: A weather alert issued by the US National Weather Service
